title: Hospital Management System
description: A comprehensive hospital management system handling patient admissions, scheduling, electronic health records (EHR), and billing. The system needs to be HIPAA compliant and support high concurrency.

modules.name: Patient Registration & Admissions
modules.description: Module for handling patient intake, generating medical record numbers, and ward assignments.

modules.name: Appointment Scheduling
modules.description: Booking and managing appointments with doctors, including automated reminders.

modules.name: Electronic Health Records (EHR)
modules.description: Secure storage and retrieval of patient medical histories, lab results, and prescriptions.

modules.name: Billing & Insurance
modules.description: Automated invoice generation, insurance claim processing, and payment gateway integration.

modules.name: Staff Management
modules.description: Roster scheduling, payroll integration, and role-based access control for medical staff.

learning_outcomes: Experience with HIPAA compliance and data security
Integrating third-party APIs for payments and messaging
project_objectives: Ensure 99.9% uptime for the EHR system

title: Telemedicine Consultation Platform
description: A secure video consultation platform connecting patients with specialist doctors. Includes real-time chat, video conferencing, and digital prescriptions.

modules.name: Video Consultation Room
modules.description: Secure WebRTC-based video calling with screen sharing capabilities.

modules.name: Real-time Chat
modules.description: Encrypted messaging between patient and doctor before/after consultations.

modules.name: Digital Prescriptions
modules.description: Securely generate and send prescriptions to affiliated pharmacies.

modules.name: Doctor Directory & Rating
modules.description: Searchable directory of specialists with patient reviews and ratings.

project_objectives: Achieve sub-second latency for chat messages

title: Pharmacy Inventory & Dispensing System
description: An automated inventory management system for a chain of pharmacies. Tracks stock levels, expiry dates, and automates reordering from suppliers.

modules.name: Inventory Tracking
modules.description: Real-time tracking of medicine stock across multiple store locations.

modules.name: Expiry Alert System
modules.description: Automated notifications for medicines approaching their expiry dates.

modules.name: Supplier Integration
modules.description: Automated PO generation and API integration with major pharmaceutical suppliers.

modules.name: Point of Sale (POS)
modules.description: Retail checkout interface supporting barcode scanning and receipt printing.

project_objectives: Automate 100% of purchase orders for fast-moving goods

title: Medical Imaging Storage System (PACS)
description: A Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS) for storing, retrieving, and sharing medical images (X-Rays, MRIs) securely.

modules.name: DICOM Ingestion
modules.description: Parsing and storing DICOM format medical images.

modules.name: Secure Storage
modules.description: Encrypted storage on cloud object storage with lifecycle policies.

modules.name: Image Viewer Web App
modules.description: Browser-based viewing tools for radiologists (zoom, pan, contrast).

modules.name: Secure Sharing Link
modules.description: Generating time-limited, encrypted links for external physicians to view images.

learning_outcomes: Handling large file uploads and storage
project_objectives: Handle uploads of up to 5GB per study
Ensure zero data loss for archived images

title: Fitness & Rehabilitation Tracker App
description: A mobile platform for physical therapists to assign exercise regimens to patients and track their recovery progress.

modules.name: Exercise Library
modules.description: Categorized video library of physical therapy exercises.

modules.name: Routine Builder
modules.description: Interface for therapists to create custom daily routines for patients.

modules.name: Progress Tracking
modules.description: Patient self-reporting and visual charts of recovery milestones.

modules.name: Wearable Integration
modules.description: Syncing step counts and heart rate from Apple Health and Google Fit.

project_objectives: Increase patient adherence to exercises by 40%
Seamless integration with iOS and Android health kits
